_comment: Where the bones of `agesandtheart:whalefall` land: on the sea bed, in the abyss and nowhere else.
`OCEAN_FLOOR_WG` is the first place above the floor, and `minecraft:template` builds up from the
position it is given, so the bones rest on the bed.
The `biome` filter at the end is what confines it -- it re-checks the biome at the chosen position, so
a sea bed that pokes above the abyss line gets nothing.
**Measured 2026-09-22, over 64 chunks of a basin that is 99% abyss**: without the rarity filter the
chain places in about half of them, so one in ten works out at roughly a whalefall every eighteen
chunks of open abyss. That is the density of a thing you swim between rather than one you stand among.
